annotations.title: Stress one instrument through the books

description: Who is liquidated as ONE instrument moves, and at what price: a ladder of shocks (round numbers, or sigma rungs from our own marks with scale=sigma) through every Hyperliquid vault book we read, with liquidated vaults, equity at risk and exposed notional per rung, the venue liquidation prices on the way down and up, and accounts already past their threshold counted apart. Only the named instrument moves, so every figure is a floor; a venue liquidation price is not a forecast. PAID (stress.read).

horizonDays.description: With scale=sigma: the horizon in days (default 30, at most 365).

instrument.description: The perpetual, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE.

scale.description: sigma: rungs at standard deviations over the horizon instead of round numbers.

name: stress_test

asOf.description: The margin snapshot the books come from.

breakPrices.description: onTheWayDown and onTheWayUp venue liquidation prices; alreadyLiquidatableAtSnapshot and unknown apart.

firstBreakAt.description: The smallest shock at which a vault is liquidated.

ladder.description: Per rung: shockPct, sigmas, priceAt, liquidatedVaults, equityAtRiskUsd, exposedNotionalUsd, shareOfEquity, vaults.

markPx.description: The mark the shocks are applied to.

measured.description: Vaults holding it whose margin we read.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

unmeasured.description: Vaults holding it with no margin state: counted, never dropped.

volatility.description: sigmaDaily, horizonDays, observations, scale and why no probability is given.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
